mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances with FEDFUNDS decline over 6 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 40% of instances with UNRATE > 4.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1250 and industrial production (INDPRO) below 102 indicates contraction in consumer demand and manufacturing output, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 40% of instances with HOUST < 1250 and INDPRO < 102, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, GDP growth below 2.0% annualized over 6 months signals economic slowdown that reduces corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 40% of instances with GDPC1 growth < 2.0% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances with PAYEMS increase over 6 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5% in a 3-month window, it signals persistent inflation that prompts aggressive interest rate policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 40% of instances with CPIAUCSL > 3.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 102 and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) below 740,000 indicates contraction in manufacturing output and housing demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 40% of instances with INDPRO < 102 and RSAFS < 740000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, a federal funds rate above 4.0% signals aggressive interest rate policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 40% of instances with FEDFUNDS > 4.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
